technical_and_design_decisions: Target runtime is Spring XD compatible with Spring Framework 6.0+ and Java 17+, built on Spring Boot 3.x for all modules

For the stream destroy --clean feature, use RabbitAdmin.getQueueProperties() to validate active consumers before resource deletion, with a fallback to direct RabbitMQ Management REST API calls until Spring AMQP's RabbitManagementTemplate is generally available, controlled by a feature flag

For security configuration, leverage Spring Security 6 out-of-the-box features with property-based credential configuration for all components; DSL shell uses Spring Shell's built-in Spring Security integration, and Admin UI shares the same Spring Security context as REST endpoints

For error channel notifications, expose the existing Spring Integration module error channel as a first-class tapable stream source, with enriched metadata (stream name, module name, exception details, timestamp) added to each error message

For status change updates, use the existing Spring XD message bus to propagate deployment/status events between containers and the admin server, with client-side polling as a fallback for UI clients to ensure no updates are missed
For the SFTP source module, use the Spring Integration SFTP inbound channel adapter, with Apache MINA SSHD embedded server for integration testing
For the Elasticsearch sink module, use Spring Data Elasticsearch 8.x with support for auto-index creation, configurable document mapping, and bulk indexing for performance

For the MVC-aware HTTP module, use embedded Tomcat 10.x (compatible with Spring Boot 3.x) with Spring MVC, leveraging Spring Boot auto-configuration for content-type negotiation and full HTTP header mapping to message headers

All ${xd.*} property placeholders are resolved via Spring's existing PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer, so documentation will cover all placeholders exposed by runtime, stream, job, and container components
assumptions: Existing Spring XD core components (CLI, Admin UI, message bus, module lifecycle management, base REST API) are already implemented and can be extended without full reimplementation

External dependencies (RabbitMQ with management plugin enabled, Elasticsearch 8.x instances, standard SFTP servers) are compatible with the versions of Spring AMQP, Spring Data Elasticsearch, and Spring Integration SFTP used in the implementation
Users have administrative access to configure security credentials via standard Spring Boot property files for all Spring XD components
The existing Spring XD message bus is capable of propagating deployment and status change events between containers and the admin server without major modifications
Users are responsible for ensuring no critical data exists in queues/topics before using the stream destroy --clean flag, as the feature will delete all associated resources
Spring AMQP's RabbitManagementTemplate will be released in a future version, and the current direct REST API implementation can be migrated to it with minimal changes via the existing feature flag
Existing Spring XD module infrastructure supports the new module types (HTTP, SFTP, Elasticsearch) without core modifications to the module deployment and configuration framework
The existing Spring XD module runtime already captures exceptions and routes them to a default error channel, so only exposure as a stream source is required for the error channel feature
